slot_note: wave 3, seed DQ13 (whether this wave's estimate trips the weighting pipeline's quality alert)
niche: a social research agency's quality report on a provincial household survey's regional estimates: which published estimates carry the low-reliability warning, each estimate's coefficient of variation under the survey's clustered design and its post-stratification to population totals by region, age group and sex
stakeholder_role: the agency's lead survey statistician, who signs off each wave's quality report for the client

spine.entity: one adult in a responding household of the 2027 wave

world.geography: Canada, an unnamed province (its twelve health regions, named by direction; the agency, the client ministry and the people are invented; personas on the en_CA index)
world.org_type: social research agency delivering a provincial household survey under contract

driver: The decisive quantity is the sampling error of totals whose weights were scaled to known population counts within cells, which is the spread of each unit's departure from its cell's mean rather than of its own value, so an error taken from the scaled weights as if they were fixed overstates the error most for the quantities the cells explain, and flags as unreliable estimates the scaling has made precise.
driver_concrete: The client's standard warns any regional estimate whose coefficient of variation is 20 per cent or more; the survey's final weights are post-stratified to population totals by region, age group and sex, so a count such as the adults receiving a public pension, which age largely decides, has a sampling error set by the residuals within the age-sex cells over the PSUs; Taylor linearisation with the final weights treated as fixed overstates those errors and warns the pension and full-time-education counts in the smaller regions, which the post-stratified estimator's variance clears.
stump: A competent analyst computes each estimate's standard error by Taylor linearisation over the strata and PSUs with the final weights treated as fixed and adds low-reliability warnings to the pension and education counts of the smallest regions; the step that lands it there is treating post-stratified weights as fixed, when a post-stratified estimate's error is that of its residuals within the region, age group and sex cells.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who builds the responding adults, attaches the final weights, reads the design's strata and PSUs and computes each estimate's coefficient of variation by Taylor linearisation with the final weights treated as fixed also warns the pension and education counts of the smallest regions; one who ignores the clustering warns a different set; only the post-stratified estimator's variance, from the residuals within the region, age group and sex cells over the PSUs, gives the golden list.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each published estimate's sampling error under the survey's clustered design and its post-stratification to population totals, the variance of a calibrated estimator that survey statisticians take from the residuals within the calibration cells; with megawatt-hours or hospital visits in place of the sampled adults there is no sample, no design, no post-stratification and no sampling error to compute.
notes: Seed DQ13: the world (a weighting pipeline's quality alert), the decision (which published estimates the wave's quality report flags) and the quantity (each estimate against the alert threshold) kept; the seed's pitfall (one overall nonresponse factor against cell adjustment) is not used: the weighting is filed and done, and the decisive step is the post-stratified estimate's variance. G17 decisive (each published estimate judged against its own sampling error, the call itself), G16 (the variance estimator the standard's sampling error of the estimate as published entitles), G2 (the PSU as the unit of the variance, a lower rung). Nearby spent drivers: task195 (a paired difference's own uncertainty), task228 (variance built at the randomised unit), task229 v1 (a standard error over entities failing through a shared node); none takes a calibrated estimator's variance from its residuals.
layer1: the fieldwork system's household and adult files at two grains beside the sample file of issued addresses with their strata, PSUs and selection probabilities
